On Tue, Feb 7, 2023 at 3:10 PM Chiusano, Erica C < > wrote:
Hi Susan, Kris, and Meral (and Vera!) - Thanks for the tremendously engaging session last week, I learned a lot! I
was wondering if it would be possible to share the contacts (or put us in touch) with some folks at the event? Given
the full program, I wasn't able to chat with everyone / wanted to grab business cards from. I'm specifically interested
in connecting with Alasdair Stuart from BBC Media Action. I'm interested in his recommendations for developing
more enabling legal and regulatory frameworks for independent media (one of the BBC's strategic objectives).
Thanks so much!
Erica

Subject: SEE YOU SOON -- MDM Learning Retreat - January 31, 2023, [contact omitted] Open GovHub, Washington, DC
Dear Colleagues,
Thank you so much for your participation in the USAID MDM Learning Retreat. We look forward to a day of
discussion, debate and ideas! Come ready to brainstorm and help us wrestle with the hard questions related to
assessing what's working and why in the MDM space.
A few reminders:
• "What's Working and What's Not: How Do We Know We Have Made a Difference?" -- Agenda is
• MDM Resource Table Reminder - In the workshop room we will have a MDM Resource Table. Please
gather your MDM related program reports, research, and other materials and come prepared to share these.
• Bring your business cards.
• Dress Code: Casual is fine. We are not a fussy bunch. Be comfortable and come prepared to talk, share
ideas, and be creativel
• Food and Snacks: We will provide a light breakfast and lunch and some small snacks, with coffees/ teas and
water.
• Location: OpenGov Hub - 1100 13th St NW Suite 800, Washington, DC 20005
